title: The Sun's Atmosphere Is 200 Times Hotter Than Its Surface

scenes.text: The Sun's atmosphere is two hundred times hotter than its surface.
The surface is about ten thousand degrees Fahrenheit.
The corona above it is over two million degrees.
Nobody fully knows why. Move away from a fire and it gets cooler. Here it gets hotter.
NASA's Parker Solar Probe flew into it, and its shield only reached about 2,500 degrees.
The air is so thin it barely touches the probe.

description:
The Sun's outer atmosphere, the corona, is over two million degrees Fahrenheit while the surface is only about ten thousand.
Scientists are still working out why, and NASA's Parker Solar Probe flew through it to find out.
What should we cover about the Sun next?
first_comment: The corona is only easy to see during a total solar eclipse. Have you ever seen one?
